name: Spewpa
dexEntry: The beaks of bird Pokémon can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

forms.name: Normal
forms.dex: The beaks of bird Pokémon can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

forms.name: Iridescense
forms.dex: These cocoon like Pokémon are part of an endangered subspecies of Spewpa known as Spewpa iridiscens. This rare subspecies is highly sought after by vivillonists and trainers alike, as it is known for its iridescent colorful coat that is rumored to shimmer with an otherworldly light at nightfall. The rainbow pattern on its coat is said to be a result of a unique genetic mutation that has been passed down through generations of this rare subspecies. This mutatuion has resulted in a cocoon made of translucent silk that refracts sunlight like a prism and causes it to almost appear to glow in the moonlight.
